title: Cloudflare's new PQ GeoKey Manager: keys that can only unwrap inside a chosen region, wrapped with hybrid ML-KEM + X25519
description: Cloudflare has introduced a post-quantum (PQ) GeoKey Manager that restricts decryption keys to be unwrapped only within designated geographic regions. This system uses hybrid post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM-768 plus X25519) to protect keys, ensuring that regional root keys never leave their authorized regions and are stored only in volatile kernel memory on authorized edge servers. The GeoKey Manager supports data sovereignty by enforcing geographic boundaries on key usage, preventing decryption outside the chosen region. It is currently in closed beta with general availability planned for Q1 2027.
